1.

O my soul! And now let Jesus Fill thy gaze entirely; See, He is in glory, Where thy sin can never reach.

2.

See in the highest glory, Seated there for us He appears, The blood that was given for atonement, Is thy praise to be there.

3.

All thy sins He bore, Bore them on the cross’s tree; God laid the burden on Him, Through faith thou art now free.

4.

God now for thee to His dwelling, Spreads a richly laden table, Bids thee come, and tells thee, All thou there from Him shalt receive.

5.

There surrounded by His favour, The Father’s love’s wide embrace! Blessedness to rest undisturbed Eternally in His safe haven.

6.

What a blessed word “for ever”! Yea, for ever there above! Nought can the redeemed Sever from their Saviour.
